protocol.name: post-hoc-support-robustness-v1
protocol.reason: A separate Bach benchmark artifact was rewritten during the original factorial run. The origin is unresolved; possible concurrent host activity motivates independent paired replication after other benchmarks have finished.
protocol.classification: Post-hoc robustness replication, not a replacement predeclared experiment
protocol.order: AB for even pair numbers, BA for odd pair numbers; A=fixed-dred, B=fixed-support
protocol.hash_seed: 3000 + zero-based pair number; identical within each independent-process pair
protocol.primary_endpoint: Complete atomic Engine.update wall seconds, including setup and validation
protocol.measurement: One cold worker per observation, no discarded warmup, no memory instrumentation; generation, output hashing and fresh-closure validation outside the update timer
protocol.correctness: Initial and updated completeness/consistency, actual full closure hashes, input and expected transaction hashes must agree with the original case and the paired worker; every worker validates against fresh recomputation
protocol.adoption: No changes to the original promotion thresholds or automatic default changes
protocol.uncertainty: Nine paired observations; raw ratios and descriptive paired bootstrap intervals; single-host evidence, no claim that all external host activity is controlled
